q: God of my father, and God of the inheritance of Israel

s: God of Israel is a God of the afflicted (helper of oppressed, weak, forsaken)
q: you are a God of the afflicted. You are a helper of the oppressed, a helper of the weak, a protector of the forsaken, a savior of those who are without hope.

s: God of Israel has name The Lord
q: ‘The Lord’ is your name.

s: God of Israel is creator of waters (also Lord of heavens and earth, King of all creation)
q: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, Creator of the waters, King of all your creation

s: God of Israel protects children of Israel (only protector of the race of Israel)
q: there is no other who protects the race of Israel but you.

s: God of Israel has attribute foreknowledge (his judgment is with foreknowledge)
q: your judgment is with foreknowledge.

s: Judith is a widow
q: took off the garments of her widowhood

s: Holofernes is a chief captain of the Assyrian army
q: Holofernes the chief captain of your army

s: Holofernes has servant Holofernes' servants

s: Holofernes rests under canopy woven with purple, gold, emeralds, and precious stones (resting upon his bed)
q: Holofernes was resting upon his bed under the canopy, which was woven with purple, gold, emeralds, and precious stones.

s: Bethulia has part gate of Bethulia
q: They went out to the gate of the city of Bethulia

s: Bethulia located on mountain (Judith descends to the valley)
q: until she had gone down the mountain, until she had passed the valley

s: Assyrians threatens Bethulia (Judith's claim that Hebrews are about to be consumed)
q: they are about to be given you to be consumed

s: Assyrians has leader Holofernes (chief captain)
q: Holofernes the chief captain of your army

s: Judith spouse Manasses (late husband)
q: in the days of the life of Manasses her husband

s: Judith has servant maid
q: called her maid, and went down into the house

s: Judith worships God of Israel
q: had ceased to cry to the God of Israel

s: Judith nationality Hebrew (self-described)
q: I am a daughter of the Hebrews.

s: Judith has appearance very beautiful (admired by Assyrians and Bethulians)
q: they all marveled at the beauty of her countenance

s: Judith's adornment purpose to deceive the eyes of men
q: She made herself very beautiful to deceive the eyes of all men who would see her.

s: Judith's adornment includes garments of gladness (worn when Manasses was alive)
q: She put on her garments of gladness, which she used to wear in the days of the life of Manasses her husband.

s: Judith's adornment includes anklet, bracelets, rings, earrings
q: put on her anklet, bracelets, rings, earrings, and all her jewelry

s: Psalms has title Psalms
Psalms has source class canonical
the wicked is like chaff (driven away by the wind)
q: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

s: the wicked will not stand in judgment (future)
q: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

s: the wicked has way that perish (future)
q: but the way of the wicked shall perish.

s: the righteous is known by LORD (LORD knows their way)
q: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous

s: LORD knows the righteous (knows their way)
q: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous

s: David is author of a Psalm
q: A Psalm by David.

s: speaker (David as ruler) favors the faithful of the land (wants them to dwell with him)
q: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me.

s: blameless walker (he who walks in a perfect way) serves speaker (David as ruler)
q: He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

s: speaker (David as ruler) destroys the wicked of the land (morning by morning)
q: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land

s: the wicked of the land is a worker of iniquity (to be cut off from the city)
q: to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

s: city (the LORD's city) belongs to LORD
q: from the LORD’s city

s: speaker (David as ruler) sings of loving kindness and justice (commitment)
q: I will sing of loving kindness and justice.

s: speaker (David as ruler) praises LORD (sings praises)
q: To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

s: speaker (David as ruler) lives blameless life (resolves to be careful to do so)
q: I will be careful to live a blameless life.

s: speaker (David as ruler) has heart blameless (walks within his house)
q: I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

s: speaker (David as ruler) hates faithless men (hates their deeds)
q: I hate the deeds of faithless men.

s: speaker (David as ruler) rejects evil (will have nothing to do with it)
q: I will have nothing to do with evil.

s: speaker (David as ruler) silences slanderer (whoever secretly slanders his neighbor) (resolve)
q: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor.

s: speaker (David as ruler) tolerates not arrogant and conceited person (resolve)
q: I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

s: LORD remains forever
q: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

s: afflicted speaker (the psalmist) is like pelican of the wilderness (likened in isolation)
q: I am like a pelican of the wilderness.

s: afflicted speaker (the psalmist) is like sparrow alone on the housetop (lonely)
q: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
